name: PickemFantasyFootball
summary: PS5 input loop for the flight cycle (R2-triangle-L2-L2-X). He asks whether the 2:41 gap in FastTips' run can be surge/phase-dashed to the extraction node.

insights.text:
Console has quick hotkeys once you open your spell book. Highly recommended setting the aoe spell to L2, so you can open spell book with triangle, L2 spell, L2 cancel.

Same theory regardless of controller or mapping preference. For me, windstep, then its ATTACK - spellbook - select spell - cancel - jump - ATTACK - repeat 

Im on ps5 so after windstep it’s R2 - triangle - L2 - L2 - X - and start looping that combo. 

Practice at your base on something higher than the ground. Cheers.
2:41 you can’t surge/phase that gap? Or at least to the extraction node and then reset position?
I’m on console and it’s pretty fucking hard to get in the loop once you get past the first refunded jump after the air step start. Makes me want to cry.
